import os
import sys

from pdf2image import convert_from_path


# Converts each page of a PDF to a PNG image.


def convert(pdf_path, output_dir, max_dim=1000):
    images = convert_from_path(pdf_path, dpi=200)

    for i, image in enumerate(images):
        # Scale image if needed to keep width/height under `max_dim`
        width, height = image.size
        if width > max_dim or height > max_dim:
            scale_factor = min(max_dim / width, max_dim / height)
            new_width = int(width * scale_factor)
            new_height = int(height * scale_factor)
            image = image.resize((new_width, new_height))
        
        image_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f"page_{i+1}.png")
        image.save(image_path)
        print(f"Saved page {i+1} as {image_path} (size: {image.size})")

    print(f"Converted {len(images)} pages to PNG images")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        print("Usage: convert_pdf_to_images.py [input pdf] [output directory]")
        sys.exit(1)
    pdf_path = sys.argv[1]
    output_directory = sys.argv[2]
    convert(pdf_path, output_directory)

def esc_pdf_text(s):
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        code = ord(ch)
        if code < 32 or code > 126:
            raise ValueError("cover text must be ASCII printable: %r" % ch)
        if ch in ("\\", "(", ")"):
            out.append("\\" + ch)
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


def text_width(s, font_size, table):
    return sum(table[ord(c)] for c in s) * font_size / 1000.0


def make_cover_pdf(width, height, title, date_str):
    """Build a minimal one-page PDF (Helvetica text) as bytes."""
    f_title = 28.0
    f_date = 16.0
    title_x = (width - text_width(title, f_title, HELV_BOLD)) / 2.0
    title_y = height * 0.60
    date_x = (width - text_width(date_str, f_date, HELV)) / 2.0
    date_y = title_y - 52.0

    title_str = esc_pdf_text(title)
    date_str_safe = esc_pdf_text(date_str)

    stream = (
        "BT\n/F1 %.2f Tf\n%.2f %.2f Td\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F2 %.2f Tf\n%.2f %.2f Td\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        % (f_title, title_x, title_y, title_str, f_date, date_x, date_y, date_str_safe)
    ).encode("ascii")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        ("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %.2f %.2f] "
         "/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"
         % (width, height)).encode("ascii"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold "
        b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica "
        b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>",
        (b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(stream)) + stream + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    pdf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}
    for idx, data in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets[idx] = len(pdf)
        pdf.extend(("%d 0 obj\n" % idx).encode("ascii"))
        pdf.extend(data)
        pdf.extend(b"\nendobj\n")

    xref_pos = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1))
    pdf.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    for idx in range(1, len(objects) + 1):
        pdf.extend(("%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[idx]).encode("ascii"))
    pdf.extend(b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
               % (len(objects) + 1, xref_pos))
    return bytes(pdf)

    if argv_target:
        if os.path.isfile(argv_target):
            return argv_target
        joined = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), argv_target)
        if os.path.isfile(joined):
            return joined
    for cand in ("report.pdf", os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "report.pdf")):
        if os.path.isfile(cand):
            return cand
    for name in sorted(os.listdir(os.getcwd())):
        p = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), name)
        if os.path.isdir(p):
            inner = os.path.join(p, "report.pdf")
            if os.path.isfile(inner):
                return inner
    raise SystemExit("report.pdf not found in workspace")


def main():
    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

    report_path = find_report(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "")

    reader = PdfReader(report_path)
    if reader.is_encrypted:
        raise SystemExit("report.pdf is encrypted; cannot prepend a cover page")
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        raise SystemExit("report.pdf has no pages")

    first = reader.pages[0]
    width = float(first.mediabox.width)
    height = float(first.mediabox.height)
    if width <= 0 or height <= 0:
        width, height = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter fallback

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    cover_bytes = make_cover_pdf(width, height, TITLE, date_str)

    cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    cover_page = cover_reader.pages[0]

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_page)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    out_buf = io.BytesIO()
    writer.write(out_buf)
    out_buf.seek(0)

    # Original content is fully serialized into out_buf; now replace in place.
    with open(report_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(out_buf.getvalue())

    # ---- Validation of the resulting report.pdf ----
    check = PdfReader(report_path)
    page_count = len(check.pages)
    expected_count = len(reader.pages) + 1
    if page_count != expected_count:
        raise SystemExit("FAIL: page count %d != expected %d" % (page_count, expected_count))

    cover_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    if TITLE not in cover_text:
        raise SystemExit("FAIL: exact title missing from cover page: %r" % (cover_text[:200],))
    if date_str not in cover_text:
        raise SystemExit("FAIL: current date missing from cover page: %r" % (cover_text[:200],))

    print("OK: report.pdf now has %d pages (cover + %d original)."
          % (page_count, len(reader.pages)))
    print("COVER_TITLE:", TITLE)
    print("COVER_DATE:", date_str)
    print("COVER_TEXT_SNIPPET:", repr(cover_text[:300]))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# Converts each page of a PDF to a PNG image.


def convert(pdf_path, output_dir, max_dim=1000):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page to report.pdf.

The cover page carries the exact title "Annual Financial Report" and the
operator runtime current date. Only report.pdf is transformed (plus the
registered pdf-skill libraries used below).
"""
import datetime
import io
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas


def find_report(start: Path) -> Path:
    """Locate report.pdf under the workspace (bounded search)."""
    if (start / "report.pdf").is_file():
        return start / "report.pdf"
    for child in sorted(start.iterdir()):
        if child.is_dir() and (child / "report.pdf").is_file():
            return child / "report.pdf"
    # Bounded recursive fallback: skip hidden dirs, stop after 2000 entries.
    visited = 0
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(start):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
        visited += len(files)
        if "report.pdf" in files:
            return Path(root) / "report.pdf"
        if visited > 2000:
            break
    raise FileNotFoundError("report.pdf not found under " + str(start))


def build_cover(width: float, height: float, title: str, date_str: str) -> io.BytesIO:
    """Render a single cover page sized to match the report's first page."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=(width, height))

    # Title centered in the upper-middle area of the page.
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    tw = c.stringWidth(title, "Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.2)
    c.drawString((width - tw) / 2.0, height * 0.66, title)

    # Current date centered below the title.
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    dw = c.stringWidth(date_str, "Helvetica", 18)
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.25, 0.25, 0.3)
    c.drawString((width - dw) / 2.0, height * 0.66 - 64, date_str)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    buf.seek(0)
    return buf


def main() -> int:
    workdir = Path.cwd()
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        target = Path(sys.argv[1])
        if not target.is_file():
            print(f"Provided path {target} not found; falling back to discovery.")
            target = find_report(workdir)
    else:
        target = find_report(workdir)
    target = target.resolve()

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = f"{today:%B} {today.day}, {today.year}"
    title = "Annual Financial Report"

    reader = PdfReader(str(target))
    original_count = len(reader.pages)
    if original_count == 0:
        print("FAILURE: report.pdf has no pages.")
        return 1

    first = reader.pages[0]
    mediabox = first.mediabox
    width = float(mediabox.width)
    height = float(mediabox.height)

    cover_page = PdfReader(build_cover(width, height, title, date_str)).pages[0]

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_page)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    tmp_out = target.with_name("report_with_cover_tmp.pdf")
    with open(tmp_out, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    os.replace(tmp_out, target)

    # ---- Validation of the resulting report.pdf ----
    check = PdfReader(str(target))
    final_count = len(check.pages)
    page1_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").replace("\n", " ").strip()
    normalized = " ".join(page1_text.split())

    ok = True
    if final_count != original_count + 1:
        print(f"FAILURE: expected {original_count + 1} pages, found {final_count}")
        ok = False
    if title not in normalized:
        print(f"FAILURE: cover page text does not contain {title!r}")
        ok = False
    if date_str not in normalized:
        print(f"FAILURE: cover page text does not contain {date_str!r}")
        ok = False

    print(f"Target PDF: {target}")
    print(f"Date used:  {date_str}")
    print(f"Pages:      {original_count} -> {final_count}")
    print(f"Cover text: {page1_text}")
    if ok:
        print("SUCCESS: Cover page added and validated on report.pdf.")
        return 0
    print("FAILURE: validation did not pass.")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    """Locate report.pdf under the workspace (bounded search)."""
    if (start / "report.pdf").is_file():
        return start / "report.pdf"
    for child in sorted(start.iterdir()):
        if child.is_dir() and (child / "report.pdf").is_file():
            return child / "report.pdf"
    # Bounded recursive fallback: skip hidden dirs, stop after 2000 entries.
    visited = 0
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(start):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if not d.startswith(".")]
        visited += len(files)
        if "report.pdf" in files:
            return Path(root) / "report.pdf"
        if visited > 2000:

    raise FileNotFoundError("report.pdf not found under " + str(start))
